scientific_scope: Selected workflows reproduce their declared stages from retained intermediate inputs. Current-paper four-arm and guide diagnostics supplement the core workflows. Optional PertRank-Q reconstructs checkpoint predictions and original subpool statistics without retraining. Raw-count preprocessing, native estimator refitting, and explicitly unavailable historical inputs are outside the default scope.

manifest.policy: All release files, including nested manifests; root MANIFEST_SHA256.json and root .git metadata excluded.

modules.reproduction_level: Optional software tests and tutorial smoke tests
modules.declared_scope: Requires a separate environment with modules/paper_analysis/software[test] installed. This verifies the software interface; it does not add biological validation.

offline_guard: Python socket/DNS blocking inherited by child Python processes; registered entry points perform no download or new model training.
